svg.aria-label: fabreak Agentic Development Lifecycle: a router on top chooses an entry; lane A for a new product, lane B for a legacy takeover; screens are approved on a Claude Design canvas before the spec; after a card round every plan task becomes its own session, run or held, then loop C: worktree, implement, verify with a dependency audit, review on Standards, Spec and Security, finish; the live plan board shows steps, metrics, worktrees and PRs; then PR or MR, merge without a question when the gates hold, tick with a metrics line, release, closing; triage turns red CI, open issues and an intake hook into cards, on a weekday schedule; back edges for review findings, replan and hotfix.

g.text: Claude Code app, git host, or human

reads the repo state (CONTEXT.md, test suite, open plan, active worktree) and picks an entry: new · feature · takeover · spike · bootstrap · fix · refactor · upgrade · docs-only · replan · release · closing · triage

svg.text: C. Build loop per session, the same for every entry

g.text: interview until the decision tree is empty
CLAUDE.md, pre-commit, CI if wanted; wizard
facts from primary sources, into the repo
spike UI: variations as canvas artboards

svg.text: then every plan task is a card at once

g.text: code map; the code is the primary source
deep modules, seams, where tests go
lock today's behaviour, one card per module
red CI, open issues, intake hook, reports
one table; picks start in one card round
CLAUDE.md: build, test, host's PR rules
the repo stays on the owner's host
run or held; at most three run at once

svg.text: replan: spec changed, remaining tasks rewritten

g.text: the app gives each card a worktree
a woken held card syncs first
the card session, tdd at the seams
green suite, then PR or MR

svg.text: review findings go back to implementation

g.text: or diagnosing-bugs: reproduce, red test first
card held until its dependency merges

svg.text: PR or MR; the board shows Review

g.text: gates hold: merge unasked; tick + metrics
UAT with the client, evidence, closing note, access
store, secrets, deploy, access: guided, done by a human
lessons go into CLAUDE.md and skills

svg.text: CLAUDE.md and skills feed the next fabreak run
hotfix: release branch first, then backport to main
